scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Institutions/Societies Belonging To Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes
other_conditions: Must be an institution/society of Scheduled Castes or Backward Classes registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 or the Indian Trust Act
Must have at least 100 square yards of its own land or land allotted/donated by the Government, Panchayat, Local Body or an individual
Second‑time grants are allowed only after five years and only after submission of all utilization certificates for earlier grants
The institution must maintain separate accounts for the grant that are open for inspection
A utilization certificate signed by the head of the institution/society and verified by a Chartered Accountant must be furnished
An indemnity bond in the prescribed format must be submitted
Grants are limited to work executed within Haryana State
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹2 lakhs (higher amounts may be sanctioned) for construction, repair, or renovation of community buildings for Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes in Haryana.
documents_required: Attested copy of the registration certificate of the institution/society
Certificate of registration of land in the name of the institution/society or any other revenue record as proof of land ownership
Documents describing the activities of the society/institution
Annual accounts or balance sheet of the institution/society
Site plan, architectural drawing, or map of the proposed building
Indemnity bond in the prescribed format
